Università degli studi di Padova.notes: Padova already publishes 2027/28: non-EU applicants abroad apply 7 Jan to 7 Mar 2027 (course factsheets), studies start 1 Oct 2027; the general page says the first call for 2027/28 opens 15 Sep 2026. Fee conflict: the course pages show 'EUR 2,950 per year, reducible by ISEE' while the 2026/27 bando sets a fixed non-recalculable contribution for non-EU students with a non-Italian household: 2,790 (group A: Economics, Political Science, Law, Humanities schools) or 2,990 (group B: Engineering, Sciences...) reduced to one third for 'poorest countries'. Morocco is not in the DM 176/2026 list (2026/27), so Morocco pays the full fixed amount. unipd.it contribuzione page cites 'DM 166/2025' for 2026/27, which is an older decree: conflict to flag. No Universitaly pre-enrolment page was found in the fetched unipd pages (non-EU abroad still need it); application fee 55 vs 60 EUR conflicts between pages; deposit 208 EUR. Economics, governance and decision-making has a separate department site (economia.unipd.it) not fetched.
